issues.on_page: Grants and contributions 80,315 (Statement of Activities p2-3: 70,315 capital grants general government, 10,000 operating grants public safety)
issues.issue: The grantor is not stated. A 70,315 capital grant to a city is often a state or federal grant, so it could be intergovernmental/state aid or federal grants. The same question applies to detail[10] (70,315, General) and detail[11] (10,000, Fire). receipts[9] already has a review flag; detail[10] and detail[11] do not.
The label says only 'Intergovernmental', so 'highway allocation' is an assumption. It is likely for a Street Fund, but the page doesn't say so and the line has no review flag.

The page doesn't say what the capital outlay bought. Construction/infrastructure is a guess; it could be equipment purchases or land and buildings. The same applies to detail[46] (Park capital outlay 8,375). Both lines have review flags.
Community building charges are usually hall rentals, so 'rentals' may fit better. This is a judgment call.

issues.on_page: Other financing uses: Transfers to other funds 1,400 / 20,700 / 22,100, added in Change in net position (-33,246 + 22,100 = -11,146)
issues.issue: The report labels the line as a transfer out ('Other financing uses', 'Transfers to other funds'), but its own arithmetic adds it. The Statement of Activities (p3: business-type Transfers 22,100), the governmental funds statement (p5: (22,100) out) and the cash flows (p8-9: 'Transfers from other funds') all show it coming in. +22,100 is consistent with the arithmetic and the other statements, but the printed label contradicts it.
